question: What is the value of \(2-(-2)^{-2}?\)
solution:
A negative integer exponent means taking the reciprocal of the corresponding positive power. Since \(-2\ne0\),
\[
(-2)^{-2}=\frac{1}{(-2)^2}=\frac14.
\]
Evaluate this power before subtracting. The requested value is
\[
2-\frac14=\frac84-\frac14=\boxed{\frac74},
\]
choice C.
